scripts.test:unit: pnpm run build:wasm && vitest run --config vitest.unit.config.ts
scripts.test:unit:fast: vitest run --config vitest.unit.config.ts src/api.test.ts src/startWait.test.ts src/apiSchema.test.ts src/chatScope.test.ts src/hooks/conversationData.test.ts src/scaleVerifierHelpers.test.mjs src/uiTeamScaleHelpers.test.mjs src/uiTeamScaleAudit.test.mjs src/verifyRustChatLifecycle.test.mjs src/components/agents/AgentProgress.test.ts src/components/chat-status/chatStatusModel.test.mjs src/sync/outboxWriteFailure.test.ts src/pythonBackendRemoval.test.mjs src/sync/draftPayload.test.mjs

scripts.test:browser:smoke: pnpm run build && node scripts/run-browser-tests.mjs --config playwright.config.ts --project=client --grep "execution settings ui|Mobile composer 320px setup renders the settled action row|Message receipt pagination browser|a real built renderer uses a new projection cache and preserves drafts|accounts settings show per-server state and provider choices|direct screens keep overlapping chat drafts and sends with their owner|direct screens automatically include paired servers on phones|a scrolled-up reader keeps its place while the agent streams|Sign-in card at phone width uses paste mode and the device code"
scripts.test:performance: pnpm run build && PLAYWRIGHT_INCLUDE_SPECIAL=1 playwright test --config playwright.config.ts --project=performance
